source.name: cambra-inspector/examples/txn_multi_read.chl
source.text:
# Transactional store read at multiple sites (RT-4a shape). Each `with begin():`
# block reads `pool` twice — once in the guard, once in the write value — so the
# transact phase substitutes the read-your-writes snapshot at two sites; the
# substituted copies must carry freshened (unique) NodeIds.
out = defer()
pool: Mut[int, Txn] := 100
for r in [10, 20, 30]:
    with begin():
        if pool > r:
            pool := pool - r
with begin():
    out << pool
out
